system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, is an employee entitled to leave to assist a spouse who has given birth? If so, for how many days, and within how many days of the birth must the right be exercised? Answer briefly, covering all three points.
raw_response: As of August 2026, under Thai labor law (Section 41 of the Labor Protection Act, B.E. 2541), an employee is entitled to leave to assist a spouse who has given birth. The employee is entitled to 3 days of paid leave. This leave must be taken within 15 days from the date of the child’s birth.
